messages:
claire (sec): Quick sync: security wants to remove CAP_SYS_ADMIN / CAP_NET_ADMIN / CAP_NET_RAW and strip common setuid bits from our base images. Need a minimal rollout checklist (discovery, KMS signing/IAM, audit logging, admission policy, rollback). Who can take which part? :eyes:
omar (infra): I can run discovery. Will scan for pods with explicit caps, hostNetwork/hostPID, and run a staging DaemonSet to list suid files. Quick kubectl for caps:`kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}
{end}' | grep -v "<none>"`
sam (eng-runtime): For rollout: 1) inventory + owner notify 2) Gatekeeper in audit mode (2w) 3) rebuild base images per-team and sign with team KMS keys 4) push to canary namespaces and monitor 5) flip to deny with an escape namespace and runbook. I can wire up the Gatekeeper constraint in staging.
jean (platform): Signing/KMS: prefer per-team keys to limit blast radius. TF module: create cryptoKey, enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs (they're off by default), grant cryptoKeySigner to build SA, and use Workload Identity. I'll draft the TF and an IAM snippet. Also recommend structured signing logs: {image,digest,builder_sa,key_id}.
claire (sec): Agree per-team keys. Also: key rotation policy -> rotate on major rebase or quarterly, and have an automated re-sign job for prod images. Ensure audit logs include signer principal and correlate to CI job id.
omar (infra): I'll post inventory by EOD. If more than 3 production owners are blocked, we'll pause and coordinate mitigations.
oncall-bot: Reminder: SEC-1201 created and assigned to omar (infra), due 2024-10-30.
claire (sec): Great. Action items: omar=inventory, jean=TF PR, sam=gatekeeper audit in staging, claire=final enforcement decision + runbook updates. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
